verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v1: falā budda min shakwā ʾilā llāhi kurbatī famā liyā ghayra llāhi jābira kasratī
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v2: waqarʿiyā bāba l-ghayri yā rabbi lam yufid lidhāka ṣarafnā naḥwa bābika wijhatī
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v3: faʾanta karīmu fal-karīmu mani t-tajā ʾilā bābihi yaʾaman ʿalā kulli niqmahi
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v4: faʾanta ḥalīmu yā ṣabūru liman jafā fahā ʾanā ʿabdu jiʾitu bādiyā dhillihi
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v5: falammā badā lī ʾannahu laysa mahrabu siwā bābika l-ḥāmī madadtu yudayyatī
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v6: ʾilayka biḍuʿfi wāftiqāri wafāqati litaghfira lī yā rabbi min kulli zallahi
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v7: fabayna yaday mawlāyā mā ziltu wāqifā dhalīlā ḥaqīrā mustaghīthā lishiddati
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v8: faʾanta ʾilahī yā mujību liman daʿā daʿawtuka yā sattāru fāstur maʿībatī
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v9: fayā rabbanā ʾiṣrif ʾilayka khawāṭirī bijāhi nabiyyi lil-bariyyati raḥmahi
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v10: fayā ḥayyū yā qayyūmu yā llāhu rabbanā ʾilayka tawaṣṣalnā bikhayri l-bariyyati
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v11: washaffiʿhu fīnā fī lliqāʾi wakullunā siwā l-ḥibbi mawṣūfu biruʿbi warahbahi
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v12: bīʾādama ʾidrīsi wahūdi wayūnusi walūṭi wanūḥi thumma ḥāwi likhullahi
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v13: wadāwuda yaʿqūbi sulaymāna yūsufi waʾisḥāqa ʾismāʿīla ʾilyāsa junnatī
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v14: wamūsā wahārūna waʾayyūba wal-yasaʿ wadhī l-kifli yaḥyā thumma ʿīsā l-wasīlati
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v15: kadhā zakariyyāʾi shuʿaybi waṣāliḥi taqīnā radā d-dārayni min kulli waḥlahi
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v16: wamin ʾāli bayti l-muṣṭafā jamʿu shamlinā biʾaṣḥābihi kashfu sh-shidādi l-muhībati
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v17: biʾaqmāri badri yā ʾilahī wasayyidī wabīlmalaʾi l-ʾaʿlā kshifan kulla ghummahi
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v18: ʾilahiyā yā mawlāyā bil-ʾarḍi was-samā wamā ḥawatā faltashfinā kulla ʿillahi
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v19: laka l-khalqu yā mawlāyā wal-ʾamru kulluhu walā takilan ʾamrī lighayrika dhukhratī
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v20: mashāriba ʾahli l-ḥaḍratayni litasqinā ʾazil biḥijābi l-qalbi maʿ kulli qaswati
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v21: maḍā d-dahru wal-ʾayyāmu wadh-dhanbu ḥāṣilu waṣāḥa ghurābu l-bayni muʿlima riḥlatī
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v22: maḍā d-dahru wal-ʾayyāmu wal-jismu ʿābidu siwā llāhi war-raḥmānu khāliqu juththatī
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v23: maḍā d-dahru wal-ʾayyāmu wal-qalbu shākiru siwāhu waminhu d-dahra jalbu maʿīshatī
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v24: maḍā d-dahru wal-ʾayyāmu wadh-dhanbu ḥāṣilu ʿalā ʾannanī mamlūku nafsī washahwatī
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v25: ʾalā ʿumra wallā mustaṭāʿu rujūʿuhu faʾarʾaba mā ʾathʾaytu sāʿata ghirratī
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v26: laqad ḍāʿa ʿumru sāʿatu minhu tushtarā bimilʾi s-samā wal-ʾarḍi ʾayyata ḍayʿati
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v27: walakinnanī ʾarjū talāfiyā rabbinā waʾillā fahabnī hālikā ʾayyā hulkahi
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v28: ʾalā himmatī fājʿal ʾilahī ʿaliyyata liʾan ṣirtu ḥurrā khāliṣā kulla wijhahi
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v29: fayā rabbi ʾimmā kuntu ghayraka ʾartajī famā ban-nā yawma l-jazāʾi waḥīlatī
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v30: ʾalā khāba ʾāmālī lighayrika rabbanā kamā nghalaqat ʾillā ʾilayka ṭarīqatī
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v31: wamā liyā rabbī ʿan faḍāʾika maʿdilu fahabniyā ʾan ʾarḍā bimurri l-qaḍiyyati
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v32: wahab liyā fī l-ʾamri th-thabāta ʿazīmata ʿalā r-rushdi hab lī sh-shukra min kulli niʿmahi
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v33: waʾasʾaluka t-taqwā waḥusna ʿibādati wanayla marāmī yā ʾilahī wabughyatī
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v34: waʾasʾalu rabbī llāha min khayri kulli mā bihi ʿālimu ghawthī ʿimādī wanuṣratī
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v35: ʾaʿūdhu bika ṭ-ṭaghwā wamin sharri kulli mā ʿalimta bihi yā rabbi jābira kasratī
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v36: waʾastaghfiru l-ghaffāra min sharri kulli mā bihi ʿālimu yā ʿālimā kulla khubʾatī
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v37: faʾinnaka ʾanta l-ʿālimu l-ghaybi kullihi saʾaltuka ʾamnā yā naṣīrī waʿizzatī
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v38: ʾalā ḥasbunā llāhu l-jalīlu jalālata waniʿma l-wakīlu llāhu nawwir baṣīratī
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v39: ʾaʿūdhu birabbī l-hādi min jawri jāʾiri wamin makri ʿādi mākiri ʾayyā makrati
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v40: waẓulmi liẓallāmi wasiḥri lisāḥiri wabaghyi libāghi yā ʾilahī waʿuddatī
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v41: kadhā ḥasadu l-ḥussādi ghadru lighādiri wakaydu likulli l-kāʾidīna bihulkatī
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v42: kadhāka ʾilaha l-ʿālamīna ʿadāwatu likulli ʿaduwwi yabtaghī d-dahra ṣawlatī
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v43: waṭaʿnu liṭaʿʿāni waqadḥu liqādiḥi wamin ḥiyali l-muḥtāli min ʾayyī ḥīlati
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v44: shamātatu shammāti wakashḥu likāshiḥi ʾilahī qinā fī d-dahri kulla baliyyati
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v45: ʾaṣūlu bika l-ʾaʿdā kadhā quranāʾunā waʾiyyāka ʾarjū min walāʾi l-ʾaḥibbahi
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v46: wamin qurabāʾī yā ʾilahī wasayyidī laka l-ḥamdu mimmā laysa tuḥṣīhi qudratī
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v48: waʾalwāni mā ʾawlaytanī rabbanā bihi mina r-rifdi wal-ʾikrāmi wāsiʿa raḥmahi
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v49: ʾilahiyā lā rabbu siwāka fayurtajā faʾinnaka fāshī l-ḥamdi ʿinda l-khalīqati
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v50: waʾanta ʾilahī bāsiṭu l-yadi fī n-nadā waghayru muḍādi yā ʾilahī biḥikmahi
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v51: wafī l-ʾamri was-sulṭāni wal-mulki lā munā ziʿu laka mawlānā fayassir bimunyatī
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v52: famā laka mawlānā ʾilahī mushāriku rubūbyyata rabbī ghiyāthī waʿumdatī
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v53: wafī l-khalqi yā mawlāyā ghayru muzāḥami liʾannaka fī l-ʾibdāʿi mawṣūfu waḥdati
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v54: waʾanta mina l-ʾakhlāqi tamliku mā tashā walā yamlikūna minka ghayra l-mashīʾati
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v55: ʾilahī biquṭbi l-ʿārifīna ʾimāminā rajāʾī waghawthī lil-ʾilahi wasīlatī
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v56: khitāmi niẓāmi lil-wilayati jumlaha bihi ʾartajī l-ghufrāna min kulli zallahi
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v57: bihi ʾartajī fatḥa l-maghāliqi kullihā wiqāyatunā t-tijjāni min kulli shiddati
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v58: wakam ʾashtakī ʿinda l-ʾilahi ziyārata zawāyāhu lakinna l-ʿināna biqabḍatī
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v59: ʾunādī wahal yujdī n-nidāʾu ʾakhā l-jawā hali d-dahru yuʿṭīnī murādī waraghbatī
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v60: wamā ziltu ʾarjūhā mina llāhi waḥdahu waʾin lam ʾanalhā yā marārata ʿīshatī
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v61: waʿadta waʾanta l-waʿdu ʿindaka ṣādiqu ʾijābata dāʿi dhī ḍṭirāri wadhillahi
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v62: ʾilahiyā fāʿfu l-wālidīna dhunūbahum kadhalika yā raḥmānu kullu l-mashīkhati
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v63: kadhalika ʾikhwānī ʾilahiyā jumlaha waman yantamī rabbī ʾilā khayri millahi
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v64: waʾazkā ṣalāti llāhi thumma salāmihi ʿalā khayri khalqi llāhi min ghayri thunyati
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v65: maʿa l-ʾāli wal-ʾaṣḥābi mā dharra shāriqu wamā qāla dāʿi yā ʾilahī lishiddatī
verses.fala-budda-min-shakwa-c1-v47: walā ʿaddahu ʿaddu ʿawāʾida faḍlika l-ʿamīmi wamin ʿawārifi r-rizqi sitratī
